about.heading: Recently graduated. Already building real systems.
about.paragraph1: I'm a recent Software Engineering graduate from IITU, focused on Python development, backend systems and AI engineering. My practical experience comes from building complete projects: a diploma project with a PostgreSQL database and an AI recommendation layer, an AI assistant integrating Telegram, WhatsApp and Instagram, and Ken Tereze AI, a Telegram-based pricing automation system.
about.paragraph2: I work with Python, SQL, PostgreSQL and Django, integrate APIs and external services, and use n8n and Claude Code to move fast on automation. I'm early in my career, but I already build complete, working systems — from database schema to a deployed product.
